origin: It means drawing only the skeleton of the content first, like a building's frame. The name spread when Luke Wroblewski introduced "skeleton screens" in 2013 as an alternative to spinners while building the mobile app Polar.
whenToUse: You load content with a predictable shape, such as cards, lists, or profiles.
You want less layout shift on first page entry.
whenNotToUse: The progress can be known, as with file uploads (use a progress bar).
A wait in a small area, such as a short process after a button press (use a spinner).
The placeholder looks nothing like the real layout.

alternatives.name: Progress Bar
alternatives.reason: Long tasks whose progress is known.

alternatives.name: Empty State
alternatives.reason: When the loaded result is empty.

accessibility: Hide the gray blocks with aria-hidden, and read a loading message once with role="status" instead.
Set aria-busy on the loading area.
The pulse animation stops with prefers-reduced-motion.
